notes: ASP = revenue / sold area, the fab's average over its mix. Sold area is delivered board/array area, so the fab's panel-utilisation scrap is already inside the CNY/m2. The best single anchor is Chaoying's 4/6-layer ASP, 995.31 CNY/m2 in 2024 (GBP 112.08/m2 at 8.88). That segment is stated to be mainly automotive, sold to Tier-1s (Continental, Valeo, Bosch) under IATF 16949; it mixes 4- and 6-layer and the split is not given. Other automotive-heavy makers agree: Dynamic's own 4/6-layer 975.78 (2022), Olympic all-PCB 1,043, Yiding all-PCB 877. To roll forward to 2026, use the stated +12-17% on automotive PCB (Sina, Q1 2026): 1,115-1,165 CNY/m2 (GBP 125.5-131.1/m2). A 6-layer premium over the 4/6 mix (not sourced; my judgement +10-20%) gives about 1,100-1,400 CNY/m2 = GBP 124-158/m2. Per board (0.0849 m2) that is CNY 94-119 = GBP 10.6-13.4. If a fab prices the poor 61% use of 2-up on 18x24 above its average (judgement, +15-25%), the figure is about GBP 12-17. The SourcifyChina 6-layer ENIG 1k-pc benchmark (USD 139-202/m2 = GBP 110-159/m2) is consistent. VIAS: 4,500 vias on 0.0849 m2 = 53,000 holes/m2, well inside the base density (PCBasic: base 100,000/m2 for 4L+; JLCPCB: surcharge only above 150,000/m2). The GBP 8.54 via line therefore double-counts drilling. Remove it: (16.56 - 8.54) x 1.30 = GBP 10.43 = GBP 122.8/m2 = 1,090 CNY/m2, which sits inside the sourced band. Our GBP 21.53 (GBP 254/m2, 2,252 CNY/m2) is 2.26x the 2024 automotive 4/6-layer ASP, about 1.9-2.0x after 2026 increases, and close to Chaoying's 8L+/HDI ASP (2,362). The tool's GBP 44.25 (GBP 521/m2, 4,628 CNY/m2) is about 2x the 8L+/HDI ASP, so not credible for a 6-layer through-hole board. Its GBP 15.16 a board class-3 microsection is unsourced here: microsection coupons are cut per production panel/lot, not per board. The only sourced class-3-type adders found are PCBasic's 25 um hole copper (+25 CNY/m2) and 4-wire test (+80 CNY/m2), about GBP 1 a board together. A 30% automotive premium on a base that already reflects automotive ASPs would double-count; the ASP evidence already includes IATF/automotive. FX: GBP1 = CNY 8.88 as instructed.
